title: Svanetian tower
visualBrief: Reusable Svanetian defensive-tower type: tall tapered warm-stone shaft, sparse recessed arrow slits and elevated closed timber door, four projecting crown faces with three deep arched mouths each, and shallow stone/slate gable roof. Medium-fi exterior based on two ordinary photographs, not a replica of a named tower.
